```{=html}
<style>
.w3{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
.w3-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px 12px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:12px;background:#fafafa;margin-bottom:10px}
.w3-grid label{font-size:12px;color:#555;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
.w3-grid input{width:100%;padding:5px 6px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;box-sizing:border-box}
.w3 canvas{width:100%;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #ddd;background:#fff}
.w3-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:10px;font-size:13px}
.w3-table th{background:#f0f0f0;padding:6px 10px;text-align:left;border-bottom:2px solid #ccc;font-weight:600}
.w3-table td{padding:5px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee}
.w3-table tr.w3-opt{background:#e8f5e9;font-weight:700}
.w3-eq{color:#dc2626}
@media(max-width:600px){.w3-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
</style>

<div class="w3" id="w3">
  <div class="w3-grid">
    <label>Récupération y<input type="number" id="w3-y" value="0.9" step="0.01"></label>
    <label>Prix métal p ($/t)<input type="number" id="w3-p" value="1525" step="25"></label>
    <label>Coût fonderie k ($/t)<input type="number" id="w3-k" value="500" step="25"></label>
    <label>Coût minage m ($/t)<input type="number" id="w3-m" value="1.3" step="0.1"></label>
    <label>Coût traitement h ($/t)<input type="number" id="w3-h" value="2.9" step="0.1"></label>
    <label>Frais fixes f (M$)<input type="number" id="w3-f" value="19.75" step="0.25"></label>
    <label>Coût opportunité F (M$)<input type="number" id="w3-F" value="0" step="0.25"></label>
    <label>Capacité mine M (Mt)<input type="number" id="w3-M" value="12" step="0.5"></label>
    <label>Capacité trait. H (Mt)<input type="number" id="w3-H" value="6" step="0.25"></label>
    <label>Capacité marché K (Mt)<input type="number" id="w3-K" value="0.1" step="0.01"></label>
    <label>Moyenne (%)<input type="number" id="w3-moy" value="1.3" step="0.01"></label>
    <label>Variance (%)²<input type="number" id="w3-var" value="3.0" step="0.1"></label>
  </div>
  <canvas id="w3-canvas" width="780" height="420"></canvas>
  <table class="w3-table"><thead><tr>
    <th>Type</th><th>Teneur (%)</th><th>Profit ($/t)</th><th>Nature</th>
  </tr></thead><tbody id="w3-tbody"></tbody></table>
</div>

<script>
(async function(){
  var $ = function(id){return document.getElementById(id);};
  var ids = ['w3-y','w3-p','w3-k','w3-m','w3-h','w3-f','w3-F','w3-M','w3-H','w3-K','w3-moy','w3-var'];

  function getParams(){
    return {
      y:+$('w3-y').value, p:+$('w3-p').value, k:+$('w3-k').value,
      m:+$('w3-m').value, h:+$('w3-h').value, f:+$('w3-f').value,
      F:+$('w3-F').value, M:+$('w3-M').value, H:+$('w3-H').value,
      K:+$('w3-K').value,
      moyenne:+$('w3-moy').value, variance:+$('w3-var').value
    };
  }

  /** Convertit la sortie de gpoly.laneAnalyseComplete (Python) au format
   *  attendu par les fonctions drawCurve/drawTable (legacy w3). */
  function _adapter(r){
    var cc = r.cc, v1 = r.v_mine, v2 = r.v_concentrateur, v3 = r.v_marche;
    var vmin = new Array(cc.length);
    for (var i=0;i<cc.length;i++) vmin[i] = Math.min(v1[i], v2[i], v3[i]);
    function eq(label){
      var found = null;
      r.equilibres.forEach(function(e){ if(!found && e.label === label) found = e; });
      return found ? {found:true, teneur:found.teneur, profit:found.profit}
                   : {found:false, teneur:NaN, profit:NaN};
    }
    return {
      cc:cc, v1:v1, v2:v2, v3:v3, vmin:vmin,
      cmax: cc[cc.length-1],
      c1:r.c1, c2:r.c2, c3:r.c3,
      c_opt:r.c_opt, profit_opt:r.profit_opt, nature:r.nature_opt,
      eq12: eq('c12'),
      eq13: eq('c13'),
      eq23: eq('c23'),
    };
  }

  // Attendre LaneUtils + Pyodide
  while (!window.LaneUtils) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 80)); }
  await window.LaneUtils.pret($('w3'));

  let busy = false, redo = false;
  async function update(){
    if (busy) { redo = true; return; }
    busy = true;
    try {
      var params = getParams();
      if(params.moyenne<=0||params.variance<=0||params.y<=0) return;
      var raw = await window.LaneUtils.analyse_complete(params);
      var res = _adapter(raw);
      drawCurve(res);
      drawTable(res);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[w3 courbe_lane]', e);
      $('w3-tbody').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" style="color:#c43a3a">⚠ '+(e.message||e)+'</td></tr>';
    } finally {
      busy = false;
      if (redo) { redo = false; update(); }
    }
  }

  function drawCurve(res){
    var cv=$('w3-canvas'), ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
    var W=cv.width, H=cv.height;
    var pad={l:60,r:20,t:25,b:40};
    var pw=W-pad.l-pad.r, ph=H-pad.t-pad.b;

    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    var cc=res.cc, v1=res.v1, v2=res.v2, v3=res.v3, vmin=res.vmin;
    var xmin=0, xmax=res.cmax;

    // Y range auto
    var yAll=v1.concat(v2,v3);
    var ymin=Infinity, ymax=-Infinity;
    for(var i=0;i<yAll.length;i++){
      if(isFinite(yAll[i])){
        if(yAll[i]<ymin) ymin=yAll[i];
        if(yAll[i]>ymax) ymax=yAll[i];
      }
    }
    var ym = (ymax-ymin)*0.08;
    ymin-=ym; ymax+=ym*2;

    function tx(x){return pad.l+(x-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*pw;}
    function ty(y){return pad.t+(1-(y-ymin)/(ymax-ymin))*ph;}

    // Grid
    ctx.strokeStyle='#f0f0f0'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(var i=0;i<=5;i++){
      var gy=ymin+i*(ymax-ymin)/5;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad.l,ty(gy));ctx.lineTo(pad.l+pw,ty(gy));ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Fill gray zone (min curve)
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(180,180,180,0.2)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tx(cc[0]),ty(ymin));
    for(var i=0;i<cc.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(tx(cc[i]),ty(vmin[i]));
    ctx.lineTo(tx(cc[cc.length-1]),ty(ymin));
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // Hatch
    ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.12)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(var d=-W;d<W+H;d+=7){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(d,0);ctx.lineTo(d+H,H);ctx.stroke();}
    ctx.restore();

    // 3 curves
    var curves=[
      {data:v1, color:'#2563eb', dash:[], label:'Mine'},
      {data:v2, color:'#ea580c', dash:[8,4], label:'Concentrateur'},
      {data:v3, color:'#16a34a', dash:[3,3], label:'Marché'}
    ];
    curves.forEach(function(cu){
      ctx.strokeStyle=cu.color; ctx.lineWidth=2.5; ctx.setLineDash(cu.dash);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for(var i=0;i<cc.length;i++){
        var px=tx(cc[i]),py=ty(cu.data[i]);
        i===0?ctx.moveTo(px,py):ctx.lineTo(px,py);
      }
      ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
    });

    // Annotations helper
    var dy=(ymax-ymin)*0.04;
    function annotate(cx,cy,label,color){
      if(!isFinite(cx)||!isFinite(cy)||cx<xmin||cx>xmax) return;
      ctx.fillStyle=color; ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui'; ctx.textAlign='center';
      ctx.fillText(label, tx(cx), ty(cy+dy)-2);
      ctx.strokeStyle=color; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx(cx),ty(cy)); ctx.lineTo(tx(cx),ty(cy+dy*0.7)); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Limites
    var iC1=0,iC2=0,iC3=0;
    for(var i=1;i<cc.length;i++){if(v1[i]>v1[iC1])iC1=i;if(v2[i]>v2[iC2])iC2=i;if(v3[i]>v3[iC3])iC3=i;}
    annotate(res.c1, v1[iC1], 'c₁', '#111');
    annotate(res.c2, v2[iC2], 'c₂', '#111');
    annotate(res.c3, v3[iC3], 'c₃', '#111');

    // Équilibres
    if(res.eq12.found) annotate(res.eq12.teneur, res.eq12.profit, 'c₁₂', '#dc2626');
    if(res.eq13.found) annotate(res.eq13.teneur, res.eq13.profit, 'c₁₃', '#dc2626');
    if(res.eq23.found) annotate(res.eq23.teneur, res.eq23.profit, 'c₂₃', '#dc2626');

    // Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle='#333'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad.l,pad.t);ctx.lineTo(pad.l,pad.t+ph);ctx.lineTo(pad.l+pw,pad.t+ph);ctx.stroke();

    // Axis ticks
    ctx.fillStyle='#333'; ctx.font='11px system-ui';
    ctx.textAlign='right';
    for(var i=0;i<=5;i++){
      var gy=ymin+i*(ymax-ymin)/5;
      ctx.fillText(gy.toFixed(1), pad.l-6, ty(gy)+4);
    }
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    for(var i=0;i<=5;i++){
      var gx=xmin+i*(xmax-xmin)/5;
      ctx.fillText(gx.toFixed(2), tx(gx), pad.t+ph+16);
    }

    // Axis labels
    ctx.fillStyle='#333'; ctx.font='12px system-ui'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('Teneur de coupure (%)', pad.l+pw/2, H-4);
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(14, pad.t+ph/2); ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);
    ctx.fillText('Profit / t. minéralisée ($)', 0, 0); ctx.restore();

    // Legend
    var lx=pad.l+pw-10, ly=pad.t+16;
    ctx.textAlign='right'; ctx.font='11px system-ui';
    curves.forEach(function(cu,i){
      var yy=ly+i*18;
      ctx.strokeStyle=cu.color; ctx.lineWidth=2.5; ctx.setLineDash(cu.dash);
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(lx-60,yy);ctx.lineTo(lx-35,yy);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.fillStyle=cu.color; ctx.fillText(cu.label, lx, yy+4);
    });
  }

  function drawTable(res){
    var rows = [
      {type:'<b>Optimale</b>',c:res.c_opt,v:res.profit_opt,nat:res.nature,cls:'w3-opt'},
      {type:'Limite c₁',c:res.c1,v:Math.max.apply(null,res.v1),nat:'Mine',cls:''},
      {type:'Limite c₂',c:res.c2,v:Math.max.apply(null,res.v2),nat:'Concentrateur',cls:''},
      {type:'Limite c₃',c:res.c3,v:Math.max.apply(null,res.v3),nat:'Marché',cls:''}
    ];
    if(res.eq12.found) rows.push({type:'<span class="w3-eq">Équilibre c₁₂</span>',c:res.eq12.teneur,v:res.eq12.profit,nat:'Mine–Concentrateur',cls:''});
    if(res.eq13.found) rows.push({type:'<span class="w3-eq">Équilibre c₁₃</span>',c:res.eq13.teneur,v:res.eq13.profit,nat:'Mine–Marché',cls:''});
    if(res.eq23.found) rows.push({type:'<span class="w3-eq">Équilibre c₂₃</span>',c:res.eq23.teneur,v:res.eq23.profit,nat:'Concentrateur–Marché',cls:''});

    var html='';
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      html+='<tr class="'+r.cls+'"><td>'+r.type+'</td>';
      html+='<td>'+(isFinite(r.c)?r.c.toFixed(2):'-')+'</td>';
      html+='<td>'+(isFinite(r.v)?r.v.toFixed(2):'-')+'</td>';
      html+='<td>'+r.nat+'</td></tr>';
    });
    $('w3-tbody').innerHTML=html;
  }

  ids.forEach(function(id){ $(id).addEventListener('input', update); });
  update();
})();
</script>
```
